units.source_text: 近处帷屏上的带子触碰了筝弦，铮铮有声。

en.t: A cord on the nearby screen brushed against the koto strings, making a clear ringing sound.

units.source_text: 想见她刚才随意弹筝时室内零乱的模样。

en.t: One could imagine how disordered the room must have looked just now as she casually played the koto.

units.source_text: 源氏公子觉得很有意思，便隔帘对小姐开言道：“久闻小姐弹筝妙手，但愿一饱耳福，不知能赐金诺否？”

en.t: Prince Genji found this very charming, and from beyond the curtain he addressed the young lady: "I have long heard of your skill at the koto, and would dearly like to feast my ears upon it; might you be so gracious as to consent?"

units.source_text: 接着又说了许多话，并吟诗道：

en.t: He then said many more things, and recited a poem:
